properties.name: additive-symbols
properties.description: @counter-style descriptor. Specifies the symbols used by the marker-construction algorithm specified by the system descriptor. Needs to be specified if the counter system is 'additive'.

properties.name: align-content
properties.description: Aligns a flex container's lines within the flex container when there is extra space in the cross-axis, similar to how 'justify-content' aligns individual items within the main-axis.

properties.name: align-items
properties.description: Aligns flex items along the cross axis of the current line of the flex container.

properties.name: justify-items
properties.description: Defines the default justify-self for all items of the box, giving them the default way of justifying each box along the appropriate axis
properties.syntax: normal | stretch | <baseline-position> | <overflow-position>? [ <self-position> | left | right ] | legacy | legacy && [ left | right | center ] | anchor-center

properties.name: justify-self
properties.description: Defines the way of justifying a box inside its container along the appropriate axis.
properties.syntax: auto | normal | stretch | <baseline-position> | <overflow-position>? [ <self-position> | left | right ] | anchor-center

properties.name: align-self
properties.description: Allows the default alignment along the cross axis to be overridden for individual flex items.

properties.name: all
properties.description: Shorthand that resets all properties except 'direction' and 'unicode-bidi'.

properties.name: alt
properties.description: Provides alternative text for assistive technology to replace the generated content of a ::before or ::after element.

properties.name: animation
properties.description: Shorthand property combines six of the animation properties into a single property.

properties.name: animation-delay
properties.description: Defines when the animation will start.

properties.name: animation-direction
properties.description: Defines whether or not the animation should play in reverse on alternate cycles.

properties.name: animation-duration
properties.description: Defines the length of time that an animation takes to complete one cycle.

properties.name: animation-fill-mode
properties.description: Defines what values are applied by the animation outside the time it is executing.

properties.name: animation-iteration-count
properties.description: Defines the number of times an animation cycle is played. The default value is one, meaning the animation will play from beginning to end once.

properties.name: animation-name
properties.description: Defines a list of animations that apply. Each name is used to select the keyframe at-rule that provides the property values for the animation.

properties.name: animation-play-state
properties.description: Defines whether the animation is running or paused.

properties.name: animation-timing-function
properties.description: Describes how the animation will progress over one cycle of its duration.

properties.name: backface-visibility
properties.description: Determines whether or not the 'back' side of a transformed element is visible when facing the viewer. With an identity transform, the front side of an element faces the viewer.

properties.name: background
properties.description: Shorthand property for setting most background properties at the same place in the style sheet.

properties.name: background-attachment
properties.description: Specifies whether the background images are fixed with regard to the viewport ('fixed') or scroll along with the element ('scroll') or its contents ('local').

properties.name: background-blend-mode
properties.description: Defines the blending mode of each background layer.

properties.name: background-clip
properties.description: Determines the background painting area.

properties.name: background-color
properties.description: Sets the background color of an element.

properties.name: background-image
properties.description: Sets the background image(s) of an element.

properties.name: background-origin
properties.description: For elements rendered as a single box, specifies the background positioning area. For elements rendered as multiple boxes (e.g., inline boxes on several lines, boxes on several pages) specifies which boxes 'box-decoration-break' operates on to determine the background positioning area(s).

properties.name: background-position
properties.description: Specifies the initial position of the background image(s) (after any resizing) within their corresponding background positioning area.

properties.name: background-position-x
properties.description: If background images have been specified, this property specifies their initial position (after any resizing) within their corresponding background positioning area.

properties.name: background-position-y
properties.description: If background images have been specified, this property specifies their initial position (after any resizing) within their corresponding background positioning area.

properties.name: background-repeat
properties.description: Specifies how background images are tiled after they have been sized and positioned.

properties.name: background-size
properties.description: Specifies the size of the background images.

properties.name: behavior
properties.description: IE only. Used to extend behaviors of the browser.

properties.name: block-size
properties.description: Size of an element in the direction opposite that of the direction specified by 'writing-mode'.

properties.name: border
properties.description: Shorthand property for setting border width, style, and color.

properties.name: border-block-end
properties.description: Logical 'border-bottom'. Mapping depends on the parent element's 'writing-mode', 'direction', and 'text-orientation'.

properties.name: border-block-start
properties.description: Logical 'border-top'. Mapping depends on the parent element's 'writing-mode', 'direction', and 'text-orientation'.

properties.name: border-block-end-color
properties.description: Logical 'border-bottom-color'. Mapping depends on the parent element's 'writing-mode', 'direction', and 'text-orientation'.

properties.name: border-block-start-color
properties.description: Logical 'border-top-color'. Mapping depends on the parent element's 'writing-mode', 'direction', and 'text-orientation'.

properties.name: border-block-end-style
properties.description: Logical 'border-bottom-style'. Mapping depends on the parent element's 'writing-mode', 'direction', and 'text-orientation'.

properties.name: border-block-start-style
properties.description: Logical 'border-top-style'. Mapping depends on the parent element's 'writing-mode', 'direction', and 'text-orientation'.

properties.name: border-block-end-width
properties.description: Logical 'border-bottom-width'. Mapping depends on the parent element's 'writing-mode', 'direction', and 'text-orientation'.

properties.name: border-block-start-width
properties.description: Logical 'border-top-width'. Mapping depends on the parent element's 'writing-mode', 'direction', and 'text-orientation'.

properties.name: border-bottom
properties.description: Shorthand property for setting border width, style and color.

properties.name: border-bottom-color
properties.description: Sets the color of the bottom border.

properties.name: border-bottom-left-radius
properties.description: Defines the radii of the bottom left outer border edge.

properties.name: border-bottom-right-radius
properties.description: Defines the radii of the bottom right outer border edge.

properties.name: border-bottom-style
properties.description: Sets the style of the bottom border.

properties.name: border-bottom-width
properties.description: Sets the thickness of the bottom border.

properties.name: border-collapse
properties.description: Selects a table's border model.

properties.name: border-color
properties.description: The color of the border around all four edges of an element.

properties.name: border-image
properties.description: Shorthand property for setting 'border-image-source', 'border-image-slice', 'border-image-width', 'border-image-outset' and 'border-image-repeat'. Omitted values are set to their initial values.

properties.name: border-image-outset
properties.description: The values specify the amount by which the border image area extends beyond the border box on the top, right, bottom, and left sides respectively. If the fourth value is absent, it is the same as the second. If the third one is also absent, it is the same as the first. If the second one is also absent, it is the same as the first. Numbers represent multiples of the corresponding border-width.

properties.name: border-image-repeat
properties.description: Specifies how the images for the sides and the middle part of the border image are scaled and tiled. If the second keyword is absent, it is assumed to be the same as the first.

properties.name: border-image-slice
properties.description: Specifies inward offsets from the top, right, bottom, and left edges of the image, dividing it into nine regions: four corners, four edges and a middle.

properties.name: border-image-source
properties.description: Specifies an image to use instead of the border styles given by the 'border-style' properties and as an additional background layer for the element. If the value is 'none' or if the image cannot be displayed, the border styles will be used.

properties.name: border-image-width
properties.description: The four values of 'border-image-width' specify offsets that are used to divide the border image area into nine parts. They represent inward distances from the top, right, bottom, and left sides of the area, respectively.

properties.name: border-inline-end
properties.description: Logical 'border-right'. Mapping depends on the parent element's 'writing-mode', 'direction', and 'text-orientation'.

properties.name: border-inline-start
properties.description: Logical 'border-left'. Mapping depends on the parent element's 'writing-mode', 'direction', and 'text-orientation'.

properties.name: border-inline-end-color
properties.description: Logical 'border-right-color'. Mapping depends on the parent element's 'writing-mode', 'direction', and 'text-orientation'.

properties.name: border-inline-start-color
properties.description: Logical 'border-left-color'. Mapping depends on the parent element's 'writing-mode', 'direction', and 'text-orientation'.

properties.name: border-inline-end-style
properties.description: Logical 'border-right-style'. Mapping depends on the parent element's 'writing-mode', 'direction', and 'text-orientation'.

properties.name: border-inline-start-style
properties.description: Logical 'border-left-style'. Mapping depends on the parent element's 'writing-mode', 'direction', and 'text-orientation'.

properties.name: border-inline-end-width
properties.description: Logical 'border-right-width'. Mapping depends on the parent element's 'writing-mode', 'direction', and 'text-orientation'.

properties.name: border-inline-start-width
properties.description: Logical 'border-left-width'. Mapping depends on the parent element's 'writing-mode', 'direction', and 'text-orientation'.

properties.name: border-left
properties.description: Shorthand property for setting border width, style and color

properties.name: border-left-color
properties.description: Sets the color of the left border.

properties.name: border-left-style
properties.description: Sets the style of the left border.

properties.name: border-left-width
properties.description: Sets the thickness of the left border.

properties.name: border-radius
properties.description: Defines the radii of the outer border edge.

properties.name: border-right
properties.description: Shorthand property for setting border width, style and color

properties.name: border-right-color
properties.description: Sets the color of the right border.

properties.name: border-right-style
properties.description: Sets the style of the right border.

properties.name: border-right-width
properties.description: Sets the thickness of the right border.

properties.name: border-spacing
properties.description: The lengths specify the distance that separates adjoining cell borders. If one length is specified, it gives both the horizontal and vertical spacing. If two are specified, the first gives the horizontal spacing and the second the vertical spacing. Lengths may not be negative.

properties.name: border-style
properties.description: The style of the border around edges of an element.

properties.name: border-top
properties.description: Shorthand property for setting border width, style and color

properties.name: border-top-color
properties.description: Sets the color of the top border.

properties.name: border-top-left-radius
properties.description: Defines the radii of the top left outer border edge.

properties.name: border-top-right-radius
properties.description: Defines the radii of the top right outer border edge.

properties.name: border-top-style
properties.description: Sets the style of the top border.

properties.name: border-top-width
properties.description: Sets the thickness of the top border.

properties.name: border-width
properties.description: Shorthand that sets the four 'border-*-width' properties. If it has four values, they set top, right, bottom and left in that order. If left is missing, it is the same as right; if bottom is missing, it is the same as top; if right is missing, it is the same as top.

properties.name: bottom
properties.description: Specifies how far an absolutely positioned box's bottom margin edge is offset above the bottom edge of the box's 'containing block'.

properties.name: box-decoration-break
properties.description: Specifies whether individual boxes are treated as broken pieces of one continuous box, or whether each box is individually wrapped with the border and padding.

properties.name: box-shadow
properties.description: Attaches one or more drop-shadows to the box. The property is a comma-separated list of shadows, each specified by 2-4 length values, an optional color, and an optional 'inset' keyword. Omitted lengths are 0; omitted colors are a user agent chosen color.

properties.name: box-sizing
properties.description: Specifies the behavior of the 'width' and 'height' properties.

properties.name: break-after
properties.description: Describes the page/column/region break behavior after the generated box.
properties.syntax: auto | avoid | always | all | avoid-page | page | left | right | recto | verso | avoid-column | column | avoid-region | region

properties.name: break-before
properties.description: Describes the page/column/region break behavior before the generated box.
properties.syntax: auto | avoid | always | all | avoid-page | page | left | right | recto | verso | avoid-column | column | avoid-region | region

properties.name: break-inside
properties.description: Describes the page/column/region break behavior inside the principal box.

properties.name: caption-side
properties.description: Specifies the position of the caption box with respect to the table box.

properties.name: caret-color
properties.description: Controls the color of the text insertion indicator.

properties.name: clear
properties.description: Indicates which sides of an element's box(es) may not be adjacent to an earlier floating box. The 'clear' property does not consider floats inside the element itself or in other block formatting contexts.
properties.syntax: none | left | right | both | inline-start | inline-end

properties.name: clip
properties.description: Deprecated. Use the 'clip-path' property when support allows. Defines the visible portion of an element's box.

properties.name: clip-path
properties.description: Specifies a clipping path where everything inside the path is visible and everything outside is clipped out.

properties.name: clip-rule
properties.description: Indicates the algorithm which is to be used to determine what parts of the canvas are included inside the shape.

properties.name: color
properties.description: Sets the color of an element's text

properties.name: color-interpolation-filters
properties.description: Specifies the color space for imaging operations performed via filter effects.

properties.name: column-count
properties.description: Describes the optimal number of columns into which the content of the element will be flowed.

properties.name: column-fill
properties.description: In continuous media, this property will only be consulted if the length of columns has been constrained. Otherwise, columns will automatically be balanced.

properties.name: column-gap
properties.description: Sets the gap between columns. If there is a column rule between columns, it will appear in the middle of the gap.

properties.name: column-rule
properties.description: Shorthand for setting 'column-rule-width', 'column-rule-style', and 'column-rule-color' at the same place in the style sheet. Omitted values are set to their initial values.

properties.name: column-rule-color
properties.description: Sets the color of the column rule

properties.name: column-rule-style
properties.description: Sets the style of the rule between columns of an element.

properties.name: column-rule-width
properties.description: Sets the width of the rule between columns. Negative values are not allowed.

properties.name: columns
properties.description: A shorthand property which sets both 'column-width' and 'column-count'.

properties.name: column-span
properties.description: Describes the page/column break behavior after the generated box.

properties.name: column-width
properties.description: Describes the width of columns in multicol elements.

properties.name: contain
properties.description: Indicates that an element and its contents are, as much as possible, independent of the rest of the document tree.
properties.syntax: none | strict | content | [ [ size || inline-size ] || layout || style || paint ]

properties.name: content
properties.description: Determines which page-based occurrence of a given element is applied to a counter or string value.

properties.name: counter-increment
properties.description: Manipulate the value of existing counters.

properties.name: counter-reset
properties.description: Property accepts one or more names of counters (identifiers), each one optionally followed by an integer. The integer gives the value that the counter is set to on each occurrence of the element.

properties.name: cursor
properties.description: Allows control over cursor appearance in an element

properties.name: direction
properties.description: Specifies the inline base direction or directionality of any bidi paragraph, embedding, isolate, or override established by the box. Note: for HTML content use the 'dir' attribute and 'bdo' element rather than this property.

properties.name: display
properties.description: In combination with 'float' and 'position', determines the type of box or boxes that are generated for an element.

properties.name: empty-cells
properties.description: In the separated borders model, this property controls the rendering of borders and backgrounds around cells that have no visible content.

properties.name: enable-background
properties.description: Deprecated. Use 'isolation' property instead when support allows. Specifies how the accumulation of the background image is managed.

properties.name: fallback
properties.description: @counter-style descriptor. Specifies a fallback counter style to be used when the current counter style can't create a representation for a given counter value.

properties.name: fill
properties.description: Paints the interior of the given graphical element.

properties.name: fill-opacity
properties.description: Specifies the opacity of the painting operation used to paint the interior the current object.

properties.name: fill-rule
properties.description: Indicates the algorithm (or winding rule) which is to be used to determine what parts of the canvas are included inside the shape.

properties.name: filter
properties.description: Processes an element's rendering before it is displayed in the document, by applying one or more filter effects.

properties.name: flex
properties.description: Specifies the components of a flexible length: the flex grow factor and flex shrink factor, and the flex basis.

properties.name: flex-basis
properties.description: Sets the flex basis.

properties.name: flex-direction
properties.description: Specifies how flex items are placed in the flex container, by setting the direction of the flex container's main axis.

properties.name: flex-flow
properties.description: Specifies how flexbox items are placed in the flexbox.

properties.name: flex-grow
properties.description: Sets the flex grow factor. Negative numbers are invalid.

properties.name: flex-shrink
properties.description: Sets the flex shrink factor. Negative numbers are invalid.

properties.name: flex-wrap
properties.description: Controls whether the flex container is single-line or multi-line, and the direction of the cross-axis, which determines the direction new lines are stacked in.

properties.name: float
properties.description: Specifies how a box should be floated. It may be set for any element, but only applies to elements that generate boxes that are not absolutely positioned.

properties.name: flood-color
properties.description: Indicates what color to use to flood the current filter primitive subregion.

properties.name: flood-opacity
properties.description: Indicates what opacity to use to flood the current filter primitive subregion.

properties.name: font
properties.description: Shorthand property for setting 'font-style', 'font-variant', 'font-weight', 'font-size', 'line-height', and 'font-family', at the same place in the style sheet. The syntax of this property is based on a traditional typographical shorthand notation to set multiple properties related to fonts.

properties.name: font-family
properties.description: Specifies a prioritized list of font family names or generic family names. A user agent iterates through the list of family names until it matches an available font that contains a glyph for the character to be rendered.

properties.name: font-feature-settings
properties.description: Provides low-level control over OpenType font features. It is intended as a way of providing access to font features that are not widely used but are needed for a particular use case.

properties.name: font-kerning
properties.description: Kerning is the contextual adjustment of inter-glyph spacing. This property controls metric kerning, kerning that utilizes adjustment data contained in the font.

properties.name: font-language-override
properties.description: The value of 'normal' implies that when rendering with OpenType fonts the language of the document is used to infer the OpenType language system, used to select language specific features when rendering.

properties.name: font-size
properties.description: Indicates the desired height of glyphs from the font. For scalable fonts, the font-size is a scale factor applied to the EM unit of the font. (Note that certain glyphs may bleed outside their EM box.) For non-scalable fonts, the font-size is converted into absolute units and matched against the declared font-size of the font, using the same absolute coordinate space for both of the matched values.

properties.name: font-size-adjust
properties.description: Preserves the readability of text when font fallback occurs by adjusting the font-size so that the x-height is the same regardless of the font used.
properties.syntax: none | [ ex-height | cap-height | ch-width | ic-width | ic-height ]? [ from-font | <number> ]

properties.name: font-stretch
properties.description: Selects a normal, condensed, or expanded face from a font family.

properties.name: font-style
properties.description: Allows italic or oblique faces to be selected. Italic forms are generally cursive in nature while oblique faces are typically sloped versions of the regular face.

properties.name: font-synthesis
properties.description: Controls whether user agents are allowed to synthesize bold or oblique font faces when a font family lacks bold or italic faces.

properties.name: font-variant
properties.description: Specifies variant representations of the font
properties.syntax: normal | none | [ <common-lig-values> || <discretionary-lig-values> || <historical-lig-values> || <contextual-alt-values> || stylistic( <feature-value-name> ) || historical-forms || styleset( <feature-value-name># ) || character-variant( <feature-value-name># ) || swash( <feature-value-name> ) || ornaments( <feature-value-name> ) || annotation( <feature-value-name> ) || [ small-caps | all-small-caps | petite-caps | all-petite-caps | unicase | titling-caps ] || <numeric-figure-values> || <numeric-spacing-values> || <numeric-fraction-values> || ordinal || slashed-zero || <east-asian-variant-values> || <east-asian-width-values> || ruby ]

properties.name: font-variant-alternates
properties.description: For any given character, fonts can provide a variety of alternate glyphs in addition to the default glyph for that character. This property provides control over the selection of these alternate glyphs.
properties.syntax: normal | [ stylistic( <feature-value-name> ) || historical-forms || styleset( <feature-value-name># ) || character-variant( <feature-value-name># ) || swash( <feature-value-name> ) || ornaments( <feature-value-name> ) || annotation( <feature-value-name> ) ]

properties.name: font-variant-caps
properties.description: Specifies control over capitalized forms.
properties.syntax: normal | small-caps | all-small-caps | petite-caps | all-petite-caps | unicase | titling-caps

properties.name: font-variant-east-asian
properties.description: Allows control of glyph substitute and positioning in East Asian text.

properties.name: font-variant-ligatures
properties.description: Specifies control over which ligatures are enabled or disabled. A value of 'normal' implies that the defaults set by the font are used.

properties.name: font-variant-numeric
properties.description: Specifies control over numerical forms.

properties.name: font-variant-position
properties.description: Specifies the vertical position

properties.name: font-weight
properties.description: Specifies weight of glyphs in the font, their degree of blackness or stroke thickness.

properties.name: glyph-orientation-horizontal
properties.description: Controls glyph orientation when the inline-progression-direction is horizontal.

properties.name: glyph-orientation-vertical
properties.description: Controls glyph orientation when the inline-progression-direction is vertical.

properties.name: grid-area
properties.description: Determine a grid item's size and location within the grid by contributing a line, a span, or nothing (automatic) to its grid placement. Shorthand for 'grid-row-start', 'grid-column-start', 'grid-row-end', and 'grid-column-end'.

properties.name: grid
properties.description: The grid CSS property is a shorthand property that sets all of the explicit grid properties ('grid-template-rows', 'grid-template-columns', and 'grid-template-areas'), and all the implicit grid properties ('grid-auto-rows', 'grid-auto-columns', and 'grid-auto-flow'), in a single declaration.

properties.name: grid-auto-columns
properties.description: Specifies the size of implicitly created columns.

properties.name: grid-auto-flow
properties.description: Controls how the auto-placement algorithm works, specifying exactly how auto-placed items get flowed into the grid.

properties.name: grid-auto-rows
properties.description: Specifies the size of implicitly created rows.

properties.name: grid-column
properties.description: Shorthand for 'grid-column-start' and 'grid-column-end'.

properties.name: grid-column-end
properties.description: Determine a grid item's size and location within the grid by contributing a line, a span, or nothing (automatic) to its grid placement.

properties.name: grid-column-gap
properties.description: Specifies the gutters between grid columns. Replaced by 'column-gap' property.

properties.name: grid-column-start
properties.description: Determine a grid item's size and location within the grid by contributing a line, a span, or nothing (automatic) to its grid placement.

properties.name: grid-gap
properties.description: Shorthand that specifies the gutters between grid columns and grid rows in one declaration. Replaced by 'gap' property.

properties.name: grid-row
properties.description: Shorthand for 'grid-row-start' and 'grid-row-end'.

properties.name: grid-row-end
properties.description: Determine a grid item's size and location within the grid by contributing a line, a span, or nothing (automatic) to its grid placement.

properties.name: grid-row-gap
properties.description: Specifies the gutters between grid rows. Replaced by 'row-gap' property.

properties.name: grid-row-start
properties.description: Determine a grid item's size and location within the grid by contributing a line, a span, or nothing (automatic) to its grid placement.

properties.name: grid-template
properties.description: Shorthand for setting grid-template-columns, grid-template-rows, and grid-template-areas in a single declaration.

properties.name: grid-template-areas
properties.description: Specifies named grid areas, which are not associated with any particular grid item, but can be referenced from the grid-placement properties.

properties.name: grid-template-columns
properties.description: specifies, as a space-separated track list, the line names and track sizing functions of the grid.

properties.name: grid-template-rows
properties.description: specifies, as a space-separated track list, the line names and track sizing functions of the grid.

properties.name: height
properties.description: Specifies the height of the content area, padding area or border area (depending on 'box-sizing') of certain boxes.

properties.name: hyphens
properties.description: Controls whether hyphenation is allowed to create more break opportunities within a line of text.

properties.name: image-orientation
properties.description: Specifies an orthogonal rotation to be applied to an image before it is laid out.

properties.name: image-rendering
properties.description: Provides a hint to the user-agent about what aspects of an image are most important to preserve when the image is scaled, to aid the user-agent in the choice of an appropriate scaling algorithm.

properties.name: ime-mode
properties.description: Controls the state of the input method editor for text fields.

properties.name: inline-size
properties.description: Size of an element in the direction specified by 'writing-mode'.

properties.name: isolation
properties.description: In CSS setting to 'isolate' will turn the element into a stacking context. In SVG, it defines whether an element is isolated or not.

properties.name: justify-content
properties.description: Aligns flex items along the main axis of the current line of the flex container.

properties.name: kerning
properties.description: Indicates whether the user agent should adjust inter-glyph spacing based on kerning tables that are included in the relevant font or instead disable auto-kerning and set inter-character spacing to a specific length.

properties.name: left
properties.description: Specifies how far an absolutely positioned box's left margin edge is offset to the right of the left edge of the box's 'containing block'.

properties.name: letter-spacing
properties.description: Specifies the minimum, maximum, and optimal spacing between grapheme clusters.

properties.name: lighting-color
properties.description: Defines the color of the light source for filter primitives 'feDiffuseLighting' and 'feSpecularLighting'.

properties.name: line-break
properties.description: Specifies what set of line breaking restrictions are in effect within the element.

properties.name: line-height
properties.description: Determines the block-progression dimension of the text content area of an inline box.

properties.name: list-style
properties.description: Shorthand for setting 'list-style-type', 'list-style-position' and 'list-style-image'

properties.name: list-style-image
properties.description: Sets the image that will be used as the list item marker. When the image is available, it will replace the marker set with the 'list-style-type' marker.

properties.name: list-style-position
properties.description: Specifies the position of the '::marker' pseudo-element's box in the list item.

properties.name: list-style-type
properties.description: Used to construct the default contents of a list item's marker

properties.name: margin
properties.description: Shorthand property to set values for the thickness of the margin area. If left is omitted, it is the same as right. If bottom is omitted it is the same as top, if right is omitted it is the same as top. Negative values for margin properties are allowed, but there may be implementation-specific limits.

properties.name: margin-block-end
properties.description: Logical 'margin-bottom'. Mapping depends on the parent element's 'writing-mode', 'direction', and 'text-orientation'.

properties.name: margin-block-start
properties.description: Logical 'margin-top'. Mapping depends on the parent element's 'writing-mode', 'direction', and 'text-orientation'.

properties.name: margin-bottom
properties.description: Shorthand property to set values for the thickness of the margin area. If left is omitted, it is the same as right. properties.name: -webkit-transition-timing-function

properties.name: -webkit-user-modify
properties.description: Determines whether a user can edit the content of an element.

properties.name: -webkit-user-select
properties.description: Controls the appearance of selection.

properties.name: widows
properties.description: Specifies the minimum number of line boxes of a block container that must be left in a fragment after a break.

properties.name: width
properties.description: Specifies the width of the content area, padding area or border area (depending on 'box-sizing') of certain boxes.

properties.name: will-change
properties.description: Provides a rendering hint to the user agent, stating what kinds of changes the author expects to perform on the element.

properties.name: word-break
properties.description: Specifies line break opportunities for non-CJK scripts.

properties.name: word-spacing
properties.description: Specifies additional spacing between "words".

properties.name: word-wrap
properties.description: Specifies whether the UA may break within a word to prevent overflow when an otherwise-unbreakable string is too long to fit.

properties.name: writing-mode
properties.description: This is a shorthand property for both 'direction' and 'block-progression'.

properties.name: z-index
properties.description: For a positioned box, the 'z-index' property specifies the stack level of the box in the current stacking context and whether the box establishes a local stacking context.

properties.name: zoom
properties.description: Non-standard. Specifies the magnification scale of the object. See 'transform: scale()' for a standards-based alternative.

properties.name: -ms-ime-align
properties.description: Aligns the Input Method Editor (IME) candidate window box relative to the element on which the IME composition is active.

properties.name: -moz-binding
properties.description: The -moz-binding CSS property is used by Mozilla-based applications to attach an XBL binding to a DOM element.

properties.name: -moz-context-properties
properties.description: If you reference an SVG image in a webpage (such as with the element or as a background image), the SVG image can coordinate with the embedding element (its context) to have the image adopt property values set on the embedding element. To do this the embedding element needs to list the properties that are to be made available to the image by listing them as values of the -moz-context-properties property, and the image needs to opt in to using those properties by using values such as the context-fill value. This feature is available since Firefox 55, but is only currently supported with SVG images loaded via chrome:// or resource:// URLs. To experiment with the feature in SVG on the Web it is necessary to set the svg.context-properties.content.enabled pref to true.

properties.name: -moz-float-edge
properties.description: The non-standard -moz-float-edge CSS property specifies whether the height and width properties of the element include the margin, border, or padding thickness.

properties.name: -moz-force-broken-image-icon
properties.description: The -moz-force-broken-image-icon extended CSS property can be used to force the broken image icon to be shown even when a broken image has an alt attribute.

properties.name: -moz-orient
properties.description: The -moz-orient CSS property specifies the orientation of the element to which it's applied.

properties.name: -moz-outline-radius
properties.description: In Mozilla applications like Firefox, the -moz-outline-radius CSS property can be used to give an element's outline rounded corners.

properties.name: -moz-outline-radius-bottomleft
properties.description: In Mozilla applications, the -moz-outline-radius-bottomleft CSS property can be used to round the bottom-left corner of an element's outline.

properties.name: -moz-outline-radius-bottomright
properties.description: In Mozilla applications, the -moz-outline-radius-bottomright CSS property can be used to round the bottom-right corner of an element's outline.

properties.name: -moz-outline-radius-topleft
properties.description: In Mozilla applications, the -moz-outline-radius-topleft CSS property can be used to round the top-left corner of an element's outline.

properties.name: -moz-outline-radius-topright
properties.description: In Mozilla applications, the -moz-outline-radius-topright CSS property can be used to round the top-right corner of an element's outline.

properties.name: -moz-stack-sizing
properties.description: -moz-stack-sizing is an extended CSS property. Normally, a stack will change its size so that all of its child elements are completely visible. For example, moving a child of the stack far to the right will widen the stack so the child remains visible.

properties.name: -moz-text-blink
properties.description: The -moz-text-blink non-standard Mozilla CSS extension specifies the blink mode.

properties.name: -moz-user-input
properties.description: In Mozilla applications, -moz-user-input determines if an element will accept user input.

properties.name: -moz-user-modify
properties.description: The -moz-user-modify property has no effect. It was originally planned to determine whether or not the content of an element can be edited by a user.

properties.name: -moz-window-dragging
properties.description: The -moz-window-dragging CSS property specifies whether a window is draggable or not. It only works in Chrome code, and only on Mac OS X.

properties.name: -moz-window-shadow
properties.description: The -moz-window-shadow CSS property specifies whether a window will have a shadow. It only works on Mac OS X.

properties.name: -webkit-border-before
properties.description: The -webkit-border-before CSS property is a shorthand property for setting the individual logical block start border property values in a single place in the style sheet.

properties.name: -webkit-border-before-color
properties.description: The -webkit-border-before-color CSS property sets the color of the individual logical block start border in a single place in the style sheet.

properties.name: -webkit-border-before-style
properties.description: The -webkit-border-before-style CSS property sets the style of the individual logical block start border in a single place in the style sheet.

properties.name: -webkit-border-before-width
properties.description: The -webkit-border-before-width CSS property sets the width of the individual logical block start border in a single place in the style sheet.

properties.name: -webkit-line-clamp
properties.description: The -webkit-line-clamp CSS property allows limiting of the contents of a block container to the specified number of lines.

properties.name: -webkit-mask
properties.description: The mask CSS property alters the visibility of an element by either partially or fully hiding it. This is accomplished by either masking or clipping the image at specific points.
properties.syntax: [ <mask-reference> || <position> [ / <bg-size> ]? || <repeat-style> || [ <visual-box> | border | padding | content | text ] || [ <visual-box> | border | padding | content ] ]#

properties.name: -webkit-mask-attachment
properties.description: If a -webkit-mask-image is specified, -webkit-mask-attachment determines whether the mask image's position is fixed within the viewport, or scrolls along with its containing block.

properties.name: -webkit-mask-composite
properties.description: The -webkit-mask-composite property specifies the manner in which multiple mask images applied to the same element are composited with one another. Mask images are composited in the opposite order that they are declared with the -webkit-mask-image property.

properties.name: -webkit-mask-position
properties.description: The mask-position CSS property sets the initial position, relative to the mask position layer defined by mask-origin, for each defined mask image.

properties.name: -webkit-mask-position-x
properties.description: The -webkit-mask-position-x CSS property sets the initial horizontal position of a mask image.

properties.name: -webkit-mask-position-y
properties.description: The -webkit-mask-position-y CSS property sets the initial vertical position of a mask image.

properties.name: -webkit-mask-repeat-x
properties.description: The -webkit-mask-repeat-x property specifies whether and how a mask image is repeated (tiled) horizontally.

properties.name: -webkit-mask-repeat-y
properties.description: The -webkit-mask-repeat-y property specifies whether and how a mask image is repeated (tiled) vertically.

properties.name: accent-color
properties.description: Sets the color of the elements accent

properties.name: align-tracks
properties.description: The align-tracks CSS property sets the alignment in the masonry axis for grid containers that have masonry in their block axis.

properties.name: alignment-baseline
properties.description: The alignment-baseline CSS property specifies the specific baseline used to align the box's text and inline-level contents. Baseline alignment is the relationship among the baselines of multiple alignment subjects within an alignment context. When performing baseline alignment, the alignment-baseline property value specifies which baseline of the box is aligned to the corresponding baseline of its alignment context.
properties.syntax: baseline | alphabetic | ideographic | middle | central | mathematical | text-before-edge | text-after-edge

properties.name: anchor-name
properties.description: The anchor-name property declares that an element is an anchor element, and gives it a list of anchor names to be targeted by.

properties.name: anchor-scope
properties.description: This property scopes the specified anchor names, and lookups for these anchor names, to this element’s subtree

properties.name: animation-composition
properties.description: The composite operation to use when multiple animations affect the same property.

properties.name: animation-range
properties.description: The animation-range CSS shorthand property is used to set the start and end of an animation's attachment range along its timeline, i.e. where along the timeline an animation will start and end.

properties.name: animation-range-end
properties.description: The animation-range-end CSS property is used to set the end of an animation's attachment range along its timeline, i.e. where along the timeline an animation will end.

properties.name: animation-range-start
properties.description: The animation-range-start CSS property is used to set the start of an animation's attachment range along its timeline, i.e. where along the timeline an animation will start.

properties.name: animation-timeline
properties.description: Specifies the names of one or more @scroll-timeline at-rules to describe the element's scroll animations.

properties.name: appearance
properties.description: Changes the appearance of buttons and other controls to resemble native controls.

properties.name: aspect-ratio
properties.description: The aspect-ratio   CSS property sets a preferred aspect ratio for the box, which will be used in the calculation of auto sizes and some other layout functions.

properties.name: backdrop-filter
properties.description: The backdrop-filter CSS property lets you apply graphical effects such as blurring or color shifting to the area behind an element. Because it applies to everything behind the element, to see the effect you must make the element or its background at least partially transparent.

properties.name: baseline-shift
properties.description: Allows repositioning of the dominant-baseline relative to the dominant-baseline of the parent text content element. The shifted object might be a sub- or superscript.

properties.name: border-block
properties.description: The border-block CSS property is a shorthand property for setting the individual logical block border property values in a single place in the style sheet.

properties.name: border-block-color
properties.description: The border-block-color CSS property defines the color of the logical block borders of an element, which maps to a physical border color depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation. It corresponds to the border-top-color and border-bottom-color, or border-right-color and border-left-color property depending on the values defined for writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation.

properties.name: border-block-style
properties.description: The border-block-style CSS property defines the style of the logical block borders of an element, which maps to a physical border style depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation. It corresponds to the border-top-style and border-bottom-style, or border-left-style and border-right-style properties depending on the values defined for writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation.

properties.name: border-block-width
properties.description: The border-block-width CSS property defines the width of the logical block borders of an element, which maps to a physical border width depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation. It corresponds to the border-top-width and border-bottom-width, or border-left-width, and border-right-width property depending on the values defined for writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation.

properties.name: border-end-end-radius
properties.description: The border-end-end-radius CSS property defines a logical border radius on an element, which maps to a physical border radius that depends on on the element's writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation.

properties.name: border-end-start-radius
properties.description: The border-end-start-radius CSS property defines a logical border radius on an element, which maps to a physical border radius depending on the element's writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation.

properties.name: border-inline
properties.description: The border-inline CSS property is a shorthand property for setting the individual logical inline border property values in a single place in the style sheet.

properties.name: border-inline-color
properties.description: The border-inline-color CSS property defines the color of the logical inline borders of an element, which maps to a physical border color depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation. It corresponds to the border-top-color and border-bottom-color, or border-right-color and border-left-color property depending on the values defined for writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation.

properties.name: border-inline-style
properties.description: The border-inline-style CSS property defines the style of the logical inline borders of an element, which maps to a physical border style depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation. It corresponds to the border-top-style and border-bottom-style, or border-left-style and border-right-style properties depending on the values defined for writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation.

properties.name: border-inline-width
properties.description: The border-inline-width CSS property defines the width of the logical inline borders of an element, which maps to a physical border width depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation. It corresponds to the border-top-width and border-bottom-width, or border-left-width, and border-right-width property depending on the values defined for writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation.

properties.name: border-start-end-radius
properties.description: The border-start-end-radius CSS property defines a logical border radius on an element, which maps to a physical border radius depending on the element's writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation.

properties.name: border-start-start-radius
properties.description: The border-start-start-radius CSS property defines a logical border radius on an element, which maps to a physical border radius that depends on the element's writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation.

properties.name: box-align
properties.description: The box-align CSS property specifies how an element aligns its contents across its layout in a perpendicular direction. The effect of the property is only visible if there is extra space in the box.

properties.name: box-direction
properties.description: The box-direction CSS property specifies whether a box lays out its contents normally (from the top or left edge), or in reverse (from the bottom or right edge).

properties.name: box-flex
properties.description: The -moz-box-flex and -webkit-box-flex CSS properties specify how a -moz-box or -webkit-box grows to fill the box that contains it, in the direction of the containing box's layout.

properties.name: box-flex-group
properties.description: The box-flex-group CSS property assigns the flexbox's child elements to a flex group.

properties.name: box-lines
properties.description: The box-lines CSS property determines whether the box may have a single or multiple lines (rows for horizontally oriented boxes, columns for vertically oriented boxes).

properties.name: box-ordinal-group
properties.description: The box-ordinal-group CSS property assigns the flexbox's child elements to an ordinal group.

properties.name: box-orient
properties.description: The box-orient CSS property specifies whether an element lays out its contents horizontally or vertically.

properties.name: box-pack
properties.description: The -moz-box-pack and -webkit-box-pack CSS properties specify how a -moz-box or -webkit-box packs its contents in the direction of its layout. The effect of this is only visible if there is extra space in the box.

properties.name: caret
properties.description: Shorthand for setting caret-color and caret-shape.

properties.name: caret-shape
properties.description: Specifies the desired shape of the text insertion caret.

properties.name: color-scheme
properties.description: The color-scheme CSS property allows an element to indicate which color schemes it can comfortably be rendered in.

properties.name: contain-intrinsic-block-size
properties.description: Block size of an element when the element is subject to size containment.

properties.name: contain-intrinsic-height
properties.description: Height of an element when the element is subject to size containment.

properties.name: contain-intrinsic-inline-size
properties.description: Inline size of an element when the element is subject to size containment.

properties.name: contain-intrinsic-size
properties.description: Size of an element when the element is subject to size containment.

properties.name: contain-intrinsic-width
properties.description: Width of an element when the element is subject to size containment.

properties.name: container
properties.description: The container shorthand CSS property establishes the element as a query container and specifies the name or name for the containment context used in a container query.

properties.name: container-name
properties.description: The container-name CSS property specifies a list of query container names used by the @container at-rule in a container query.

properties.name: container-type
properties.description: The container-type CSS property is used to define the type of containment used in a container query.

properties.name: content-visibility
properties.description: Controls whether or not an element renders its contents at all, along with forcing a strong set of containments, allowing user agents to potentially omit large swathes of layout and rendering work until it becomes needed.

properties.name: counter-set
properties.description: The counter-set CSS property sets a CSS counter to a given value. It manipulates the value of existing counters, and will only create new counters if there isn't already a counter of the given name on the element.

properties.name: cx
properties.description: The cx CSS property defines the x-axis center point of an SVG circle or ellipse element. If present, it overrides the element's cx attribute.

properties.name: cy
properties.description: The cy CSS property defines the y-axis center point of an SVG circle or ellipse elements. If present, it overrides the element's cy attribute.

properties.name: d
properties.description: The d CSS property defines a path to be drawn by the SVG path element. If present, it overrides the element's d attribute.

properties.name: dominant-baseline
properties.description: The dominant-baseline CSS property specifies the specific baseline used to align the box's text and inline-level contents. It also indicates the default alignment baseline of any boxes participating in baseline alignment in the box's alignment context. If present, it overrides the shape's dominant-baseline attribute.
properties.syntax: auto | text-bottom | alphabetic | ideographic | middle | central | mathematical | hanging | text-top

properties.name: field-sizing
properties.description: The field-sizing CSS property enables you to control the sizing behavior of elements that are given a default preferred size, such as form control elements. This property enables you to override the default sizing behavior, allowing form controls to adjust in size to fit their contents.

properties.name: font-optical-sizing
properties.description: The font-optical-sizing CSS property allows developers to control whether browsers render text with slightly differing visual representations to optimize viewing at different sizes, or not. This only works for fonts that have an optical size variation axis.

properties.name: font-palette
properties.description: The font-palette CSS property allows specifying one of the many palettes contained in a font that a user agent should use for the font. Users can also override the values in a palette or create a new palette by using the @font-palette-values at-rule.

properties.name: font-smooth
properties.description: The font-smooth CSS property controls the application of anti-aliasing when fonts are rendered.

properties.name: font-synthesis-position
properties.description: The font-synthesis-position CSS property lets you specify whether or not a browser may synthesize the subscript and superscript "position" typefaces when they are missing in a font family, while using font-variant-position to set the positions.

properties.name: font-synthesis-small-caps
properties.description: The font-synthesis-small-caps CSS property lets you specify whether or not the browser may synthesize small-caps typeface when it is missing in a font family. Small-caps glyphs typically use the form of uppercase letters but are reduced to the size of lowercase letters.

properties.name: font-synthesis-style
properties.description: The font-synthesis-style CSS property lets you specify whether or not the browser may synthesize the oblique typeface when it is missing in a font family.

properties.name: font-synthesis-weight
properties.description: The font-synthesis-weight CSS property lets you specify whether or not the browser may synthesize the bold typeface when it is missing in a font family.

properties.name: font-variant-emoji
properties.description: The font-variant-emoji CSS property specifies the default presentation style for displaying emojis.

properties.name: font-variation-settings
properties.description: The font-variation-settings CSS property provides low-level control over OpenType or TrueType font variations, by specifying the four letter axis names of the features you want to vary, along with their variation values.

properties.name: font-width
properties.syntax: normal | <percentage [0,∞]> | ultra-condensed | extra-condensed | condensed | semi-condensed | semi-expanded | expanded | extra-expanded | ultra-expanded

properties.name: forced-color-adjust
properties.description: Allows authors to opt certain elements out of forced colors mode. This then restores the control of those values to CSS

properties.name: gap
properties.description: The gap CSS property is a shorthand property for row-gap and column-gap specifying the gutters between grid rows and columns.

properties.name: hanging-punctuation
properties.description: The hanging-punctuation CSS property specifies whether a punctuation mark should hang at the start or end of a line of text. Hanging punctuation may be placed outside the line box.

properties.name: hyphenate-character
properties.description: A hyphenate character used at the end of a line.

properties.name: hyphenate-limit-chars
properties.description: The hyphenate-limit-chars CSS property specifies the minimum word length to allow hyphenation of words as well as the minimum number of characters before and after the hyphen.

properties.name: image-resolution
properties.description: The image-resolution property specifies the intrinsic resolution of all raster images used in or on the element. It affects both content images (e.g. replaced elements and generated content) and decorative images (such as background-image). The intrinsic resolution of an image is used to determine the image’s intrinsic dimensions.

properties.name: initial-letter
properties.description: The initial-letter CSS property specifies styling for dropped, raised, and sunken initial letters.

properties.name: initial-letter-align
properties.description: The initial-letter-align CSS property specifies the alignment of initial letters within a paragraph.

properties.name: inset
properties.description: The inset CSS property defines the logical block and inline start and end offsets of an element, which map to physical offsets depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation. It corresponds to the top and bottom, or right and left properties depending on the values defined for writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation.

properties.name: inset-block
properties.description: The inset-block CSS property defines the logical block start and end offsets of an element, which maps to physical offsets depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation. It corresponds to the top and bottom, or right and left properties depending on the values defined for writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation.

properties.name: inset-block-end
properties.description: The inset-block-end CSS property defines the logical block end offset of an element, which maps to a physical offset depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation. It corresponds to the top, right, bottom, or left property depending on the values defined for writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation.

properties.name: inset-block-start
properties.description: The inset-block-start CSS property defines the logical block start offset of an element, which maps to a physical offset depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation. It corresponds to the top, right, bottom, or left property depending on the values defined for writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation.

properties.name: inset-inline
properties.description: The inset-inline CSS property defines the logical block start and end offsets of an element, which maps to physical offsets depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation. It corresponds to the top and bottom, or right and left properties depending on the values defined for writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation.

properties.name: inset-inline-end
properties.description: The inset-inline-end CSS property defines the logical inline end inset of an element, which maps to a physical inset depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation. It corresponds to the top, right, bottom, or left property depending on the values defined for writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation.

properties.name: inset-inline-start
properties.description: The inset-inline-start CSS property defines the logical inline start inset of an element, which maps to a physical offset depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation. It corresponds to the top, right, bottom, or left property depending on the values defined for writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation.

properties.name: interpolate-size
properties.description: The interpolate-size CSS property allows you to enable animations and transitions between a <length-percentage> value and an intrinsic size value such as auto, fit-content, or max-content.

properties.name: justify-tracks
properties.description: The justify-tracks CSS property sets the alignment in the masonry axis for grid containers that have masonry in their inline axis

properties.name: line-clamp
properties.description: The line-clamp property allows limiting the contents of a block container to the specified number of lines; remaining content is fragmented away and neither rendered nor measured. Optionally, it also allows inserting content into the last line box to indicate the continuity of truncated/interrupted content.

properties.name: line-height-step
properties.description: The line-height-step CSS property defines the step units for line box heights. When the step unit is positive, line box heights are rounded up to the closest multiple of the unit. Negative values are invalid.

properties.name: margin-block
properties.description: The margin-block CSS property defines the logical block start and end margins of an element, which maps to physical margins depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation.

properties.name: margin-inline
properties.description: The margin-inline CSS property defines the logical inline start and end margins of an element, which maps to physical margins depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation.

properties.name: margin-trim
properties.description: The margin-trim property allows the container to trim the margins of its children where they adjoin the container’s edges.

properties.name: mask
properties.description: The mask CSS property alters the visibility of an element by either partially or fully hiding it. This is accomplished by either masking or clipping the image at specific points.

properties.name: mask-border
properties.description:
The mask-border CSS property lets you create a mask along the edge of an element's border.

This property is a shorthand for mask-border-source, mask-border-slice, mask-border-width, mask-border-outset, mask-border-repeat, and mask-border-mode. As with all shorthand properties, any omitted sub-values will be set to their initial value.

properties.name: mask-border-mode
properties.description: The mask-border-mode CSS property specifies the blending mode used in a mask border.

properties.name: mask-border-outset
properties.description: The mask-border-outset CSS property specifies the distance by which an element's mask border is set out from its border box.

properties.name: mask-border-repeat
properties.description: The mask-border-repeat CSS property defines how the edge regions of a source image are adjusted to fit the dimensions of an element's mask border.

properties.name: mask-border-slice
properties.description: The mask-border-slice CSS property divides the image specified by mask-border-source into regions. These regions are used to form the components of an element's mask border.

properties.name: mask-border-source
properties.description:
The mask-border-source CSS property specifies the source image used to create an element's mask border.

The mask-border-slice property is used to divide the source image into regions, which are then dynamically applied to the final mask border.

properties.name: mask-border-width
properties.description: The mask-border-width CSS property specifies the width of an element's mask border.

properties.name: mask-clip
properties.description: The mask-clip CSS property determines the area, which is affected by a mask. The painted content of an element must be restricted to this area.

properties.name: mask-composite
properties.description: The mask-composite CSS property represents a compositing operation used on the current mask layer with the mask layers below it.

properties.name: masonry-auto-flow
properties.description: The masonry-auto-flow CSS property modifies how items are placed when using masonry in CSS Grid Layout.

properties.name: math-depth
properties.description: Describe a notion of "depth" for each element of a mathematical formula, with respect to the top-level container of that formula.

properties.name: math-shift
properties.description: Used for positioning superscript during the layout of MathML scripted elements.

properties.name: math-style
properties.description: The math-style property indicates whether MathML equations should render with normal or compact height.

properties.name: max-lines
properties.description: The max-lines property forces a break after a set number of lines

properties.name: object-view-box
properties.description: Defines a rectangle as a viewable area (viewbox) within a replaced element, enabling the content of the replaced element to be zoomed or panned.

properties.name: offset
properties.description: The offset CSS property is a shorthand property for animating an element along a defined path.

properties.name: offset-anchor
properties.description: Defines an anchor point of the box positioned along the path. The anchor point specifies the point of the box which is to be considered as the point that is moved along the path.

properties.name: offset-distance
properties.description: The offset-distance CSS property specifies a position along an offset-path.

properties.name: offset-path
properties.description:
The offset-path CSS property specifies the offset path where the element gets positioned. The exact element’s position on the offset path is determined by the offset-distance property. An offset path is either a specified path with one or multiple sub-paths or the geometry of a not-styled basic shape. Each shape or path must define an initial position for the computed value of "0" for offset-distance and an initial direction which specifies the rotation of the object to the initial position.

In this specification, a direction (or rotation) of 0 degrees is equivalent to the direction of the positive x-axis in the object’s local coordinate system. In other words, a rotation of 0 degree points to the right side of the UA if the object and its ancestors have no transformation applied.

properties.name: offset-position
properties.description: Specifies the initial position of the offset path. If position is specified with static, offset-position would be ignored.

properties.name: offset-rotate
properties.description: The offset-rotate CSS property defines the direction of the element while positioning along the offset path.

properties.name: overflow-anchor
properties.description: The overflow-anchor CSS property provides a way to opt out browser scroll anchoring behavior which adjusts scroll position to minimize content shifts.

properties.name: overflow-block
properties.description: The overflow-block CSS media feature can be used to test how the output device handles content that overflows the initial containing block along the block axis.

properties.name: overflow-clip-box
properties.description: The overflow-clip-box CSS property specifies relative to which box the clipping happens when there is an overflow. It is short hand for the overflow-clip-box-inline and overflow-clip-box-block properties.

properties.name: overflow-clip-margin
properties.description: The overflow-clip-margin CSS property determines how far outside its bounds an element with overflow: clip may be painted before being clipped.

properties.name: overflow-inline
properties.description: The overflow-inline CSS media feature can be used to test how the output device handles content that overflows the initial containing block along the inline axis.

properties.name: overlay
properties.description: The overlay CSS property specifies whether an element appearing in the top layer (for example, a shown popover or modal {{htmlelement("dialog")}} element) is actually rendered in the top layer. This property is only relevant within a list of transition-property values, and only if allow-discrete is set as the transition-behavior.

properties.name: overscroll-behavior
properties.description: The overscroll-behavior CSS property is shorthand for the overscroll-behavior-x and overscroll-behavior-y properties, which allow you to control the browser's scroll overflow behavior — what happens when the boundary of a scrolling area is reached.

properties.name: overscroll-behavior-block
properties.description: The overscroll-behavior-block CSS property sets the browser's behavior when the block direction boundary of a scrolling area is reached.

properties.name: overscroll-behavior-inline
properties.description: The overscroll-behavior-inline CSS property sets the browser's behavior when the inline direction boundary of a scrolling area is reached.

properties.name: overscroll-behavior-x
properties.description: The overscroll-behavior-x CSS property is allows you to control the browser's scroll overflow behavior — what happens when the boundary of a scrolling area is reached — in the x axis direction.

properties.name: overscroll-behavior-y
properties.description: The overscroll-behavior-y CSS property is allows you to control the browser's scroll overflow behavior — what happens when the boundary of a scrolling area is reached — in the y axis direction.

properties.name: padding-block
properties.description: The padding-block CSS property defines the logical block start and end padding of an element, which maps to physical padding properties depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation.

properties.name: padding-inline
properties.description: The padding-inline CSS property defines the logical inline start and end padding of an element, which maps to physical padding properties depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation.

properties.name: page
properties.description: The page CSS property is used to specify the named page, a specific type of page defined by the @page at-rule.

properties.name: place-content
properties.description: The place-content CSS shorthand property sets both the align-content and justify-content properties.

properties.name: place-items
properties.description: The CSS place-items shorthand property sets both the align-items and justify-items properties. The first value is the align-items property value, the second the justify-items one. If the second value is not present, the first value is also used for it.

properties.name: place-self
properties.description: The place-self CSS property is a shorthand property sets both the align-self and justify-self properties. The first value is the align-self property value, the second the justify-self one. If the second value is not present, the first value is also used for it.

properties.name: position-anchor
properties.description: The position-anchor property defines the default anchor specifier for all anchor functions on the element, allowing multiple elements to use the same set of anchor functions (and position options lists!) while changing which anchor element each is referring to.

properties.name: position-area
properties.description: The position-area CSS property enables an anchor-positioned element to be positioned relative to the edges of its associated anchor element by placing the positioned element on one or more tiles of an implicit 3x3 grid, where the anchoring element is the center cell.

properties.name: position-try
properties.description: This shorthand sets both position-try-options and position-try-order. If <'position-try-order'> is omitted, it’s set to the property’s initial value.

properties.name: position-try-fallbacks
properties.description: The position-try-fallbacks CSS property enables you to specify a list of one or more alternative position try fallback options for anchor-positioned elements to be placed relative to their associated anchor elements. When the element would otherwise overflow its inset-modified containing block, the browser will try placing the positioned element in these different fallback positions, in the order provided, until it finds a value that stops it from overflowing its container or the viewport.

properties.name: position-try-order
properties.description: This property specifies the order in which the position options list will be tried.

properties.name: position-visibility
properties.description: There are times when an element’s anchors are not appropriate for positioning the element with, and it would be better to simply not display the element at all. position-visibility provides several conditions where this could be the case.

properties.name: print-color-adjust
properties.description: Defines what optimization the user agent is allowed to do when adjusting the appearance for an output device.

properties.name: r
properties.description: The r CSS property defines the radius of a circle. It can only be used with the SVG circle element. If present, it overrides the circle's r attribute.

properties.name: reading-flow
properties.syntax: normal | source-order | flex-visual | flex-flow | grid-rows | grid-columns | grid-order

properties.name: rotate
properties.description: The rotate CSS property allows you to specify rotation transforms individually and independently of the transform property. This maps better to typical user interface usage, and saves having to remember the exact order of transform functions to specify in the transform value.

properties.name: row-gap
properties.description: The row-gap CSS property specifies the gutter between grid rows.

properties.name: ruby-merge
properties.description: This property controls how ruby annotation boxes should be rendered when there are more than one in a ruby container box: whether each pair should be kept separate, the annotations should be collapsed and rendered as a group, or the separation should be determined based on the space available.

properties.name: rx
properties.description: The rx CSS property defines the x-axis, or horizontal, radius of an SVG ellipse and the horizontal curve of the corners of an SVG rect rectangle. If present, it overrides the shape's rx attribute.

properties.name: ry
properties.description: The ry CSS property defines the y-axis, or vertical, radius of an SVG ellipse and the vertical curve of the corners of an SVG rect rectangle. If present, it overrides the shape's ry attribute.

properties.name: scale
properties.description: The scale CSS property allows you to specify scale transforms individually and independently of the transform property. This maps better to typical user interface usage, and saves having to remember the exact order of transform functions to specify in the transform value.

properties.name: scroll-margin
properties.description: The scroll-margin property is a shorthand property which sets all of the scroll-margin longhands, assigning values much like the margin property does for the margin-* longhands.

properties.name: scroll-margin-block
properties.description: The scroll-margin-block property is a shorthand property which sets the scroll-margin longhands in the block dimension.

properties.name: scroll-margin-block-end
properties.description: The scroll-margin-block-end property defines the margin of the scroll snap area at the end of the block dimension that is used for snapping this box to the snapport. The scroll snap area is determined by taking the transformed border box, finding its rectangular bounding box (axis-aligned in the scroll container’s coordinate space), then adding the specified outsets.

properties.name: scroll-margin-block-start
properties.description: The scroll-margin-block-start property defines the margin of the scroll snap area at the start of the block dimension that is used for snapping this box to the snapport. The scroll snap area is determined by taking the transformed border box, finding its rectangular bounding box (axis-aligned in the scroll container’s coordinate space), then adding the specified outsets.

properties.name: scroll-margin-bottom
properties.description: The scroll-margin-bottom property defines the bottom margin of the scroll snap area that is used for snapping this box to the snapport. The scroll snap area is determined by taking the transformed border box, finding its rectangular bounding box (axis-aligned in the scroll container’s coordinate space), then adding the specified outsets.

properties.name: scroll-margin-inline
properties.description: The scroll-margin-inline property is a shorthand property which sets the scroll-margin longhands in the inline dimension.

properties.name: scroll-margin-inline-end
properties.description: The scroll-margin-inline-end property defines the margin of the scroll snap area at the end of the inline dimension that is used for snapping this box to the snapport. The scroll snap area is determined by taking the transformed border box, finding its rectangular bounding box (axis-aligned in the scroll container’s coordinate space), then adding the specified outsets.

properties.name: scroll-margin-inline-start
properties.description: The scroll-margin-inline-start property defines the margin of the scroll snap area at the start of the inline dimension that is used for snapping this box to the snapport. The scroll snap area is determined by taking the transformed border box, finding its rectangular bounding box (axis-aligned in the scroll container’s coordinate space), then adding the specified outsets.

properties.name: scroll-margin-left
properties.description: The scroll-margin-left property defines the left margin of the scroll snap area that is used for snapping this box to the snapport.
